candidate.rollback: Disable the high-risk deterministic renderer and retain the engine-owned envelope as diagnostic state; no serving pointer is changed.

experiment.uncertainty_rule: Wilson 95% lower bound must exceed the historical baseline rate.

falsifier: Fewer than 20 eligible prospective episodes, success rate below 0.75, Wilson lower bound not above baseline, any critical identity regression, or independent-evaluator rejection.
mechanism: Render identity, relationship, next action, clarification, evidence posture, and decision options from closed templates; use unrestricted model prose only outside detected high-risk transitions.
statement: A deterministic bilingual continuity renderer over an engine-owned envelope will eliminate model re-interpretation at high-risk scope transitions.
